text.p: Medialink Worldwide Inc said Tuesday it acquired Corporate Television Group Inc for $4 million in cash and stock.

In addition, earn-out provisions allow for up to an additional $6.2 million to be paid based on the achievement of certain revenue and profitability targets and leverage gained through cross-marketing Medialink clients over the next five years.
Corporate Television, formerly Reuters Corporate Television, a division of Reuters New Media Inc, will be operated as a division of Medialink under the name Medialink Corporate Television.

Laurence Moskowitz, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Medialink, said, "The acquisition will be immediately accretive to earnings, adds critical mass and should bring additional operating efficiencies to our business."
Corporate Television is based in New York and provides strategic video communications consulting and production services for internal and external audiences.
Medialink provides video and audio production and satellite distribution services for corporations and other organizations seeking to communicate their news to the public.
